title: 第19章 道种
content_zh:
魏乐府眉头紧皱，他本以为时间已经过去了七天，可结果并不是。

    具体过去了多久他不清楚，但可以确定绝对不会超过十分钟。

    甚至再大胆点，一分钟以内也有可能。

    这件事很快就被他抛之脑后了，这对于他来说是一件好事。

    不管是什么原理，至少省下了他不少麻烦。

    他把事情安排妥当后，就开始炼化先天灵根这件天材地宝。

    倒是难度不大，入手时搭配了对应的炼化方式。

    再加上本质上就是个低魔世界，所以前后半个小时就将其炼化，并且消化吸收了。

    魏乐府适应着自己的变化，如今他的位次变成了天级+天级，不过还是排在第三。

    “我这资质，好像是天级守门员...”魏乐府吐槽了一句。

    他的资质虽然被先天灵根提升到了天级，但只属于刚迈过天级门槛。

    最大的变化，应该就是他的体内多了一个...技能树？

    好吧，说是技能树，实际上应该叫做道种，这下道种点就有了去处。

    目前只开放了1层道种，天级资质的炼气士和其他练气相比，就是多了道种。

    魏乐府的目光扫过了这些个道种，数量不多但他全都想要。

    有能够提升三维上限的，也有能够提升重楼功等级的...不过这两个道种被他直接无视了。

    道种点有限，这两个可以自己提升，完全没有必要点。

    然后落在了黄巾力士系列道种，他左看右看之后...暂时搁置了下来。

    点了这些道种之后，确实能够让这个先天法术提升强度和获得新效果。

    但对于魏乐府来说帮助不是很大。

    而且他发现，作为后天法术的重楼功只能提升等级，但作为先天法术的黄巾力士却有着更高的潜力和上限。

    当然，重点不在这里，而是在神通系列的道种。

    神通系列的道种，应该就是让老弟拥有成长性的关键。

    只是...魏乐府发现，好像只能提升老弟的强度，不能提升老弟的心智。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu frowned. He thought that seven days had passed, but it turned out not to be the case.

He didn't know exactly how much time had passed, but he was certain that it would never exceed ten minutes.

Even if you are bolder, it is possible in less than a minute.

The incident was quickly forgotten, which was a good thing for him.

No matter what the principle was, at least it saved him a lot of trouble.

After he arranged things properly, he began to refine the innate spiritual root, a treasure of heaven and earth.

It's not that difficult, and it comes with the corresponding refining method when you start it.

In addition, it is essentially a low-demon world, so it was refined, digested and absorbed within half an hour.

Wei Yuefu adapted to his changes, and now his ranking has become Heaven Level + Heaven Level, but he is still ranked third.

"With my qualifications, I seem to be a heaven-level goalkeeper..." Wei Yuefu complained.

Although his qualifications have been upgraded to the heaven level by his innate spiritual roots, he has only just crossed the threshold of the heaven level.

The biggest change is probably that he has an extra...skill tree in his body?

Well, it is said to be a skill tree, but it should actually be called Tao Seed, so the Tao Seed point will have a place to go.

Currently, only one level of Tao seeds is open. Compared with other Qi practitioners, Qi practitioners with heaven-level qualifications have more Tao seeds.

Wei Yuefu's eyes swept over these Tao seeds. There were not many in number, but he wanted them all.

There are those that can increase the upper limit of three dimensions, and there are also those that can increase the level of Chonglou Gong... But these two types of Taoist skills were ignored by him.

Taoist points are limited, you can improve these two by yourself, there is no need to point them at all.

Then he landed on the Yellow Turban Rikishi series. After looking left and right... he put it aside for the time being.

After clicking these Tao seeds, this innate spell can indeed increase its intensity and obtain new effects.

But it was not very helpful to Wei Yuefu.

Moreover, he discovered that Chonglou Gong, which is an acquired spell, can only increase the level, but Huangjin Rikishi, which is an innate spell, has higher potential and upper limit.

Of course, the focus is not here, but on the Tao seeds of the magical power series.

The Tao seeds of the magical power series should be the key to giving me the ability to grow.

But... Wei Yuefu discovered that it seemed that it could only improve his strength, but not his mind.
